User Goal: Summarize the active onboarding document and add a first-session checklist
Given: Getting Started/Welcome to Kition.md is the active document and contains the seeded onboarding guide
When: The user asks: Summarize this page in five bullets and add a checklist for my first Kition session
Expected Business Result: The Agent returns a five-bullet summary and appends one readable checklist to the active Markdown document
Critical Checks: The request is bound to Getting Started/Welcome to Kition.md; the Agent reads the active file; exactly one document write targets the same path; the saved document remains valid Markdown; no table or unrelated file changes
Negative or Recovery Branch: If the prompt asks only for a summary, no document write is allowed; if writing fails, the original document stays intact and the failure is visible
Coverage Status: Covered (mocked agent stream): binding to the open guide, one reported write to that file only, summary-only writes nothing, a failed write is shown and the guide is unchanged

User Goal: Generate a concise summary for one reading-list row on demand
Given: The selected row contains Title and URL and the AI Summary field has auto_update=false with the seeded 2-3 sentence prompt
When: The user explicitly runs AI Summary for one cell
Expected Business Result: Only that cell receives a non-empty 2-3 sentence summary based on the selected row; source fields and other rows remain unchanged
Critical Checks: One model request; correct row and field; no automatic generation before the click; result persists after reload; rerun replaces the target cell once rather than appending duplicate text
Negative or Recovery Branch: On provider timeout or cancellation, the previous cell value and all source fields remain unchanged and the cell is retryable
Coverage Status: Covered; fixed: the seeded AI Summary prompt now names the row (Title, URL), which it did not. No run before the click, one request for the asked row, persisted, rerun replaces, timeout keeps the value and can be retried

User Goal: Turn uploaded receipt files into structured reviewable data
Given: The user attaches a known receipt image or PDF and uses the onboarding extraction prompt
When: The user starts the receipt-processing scenario
Expected Business Result: The generated table contains source filename, vendor, address, category, transaction date, total, and tax fields with one traceable row per receipt
Critical Checks: The attachment is included once; progress reaches completion; extracted values map to the correct receipt; source files remain available; the completed table can be reopened after reload
Negative or Recovery Branch: A malformed receipt becomes a reviewable failed or incomplete row without blocking valid receipts; cancellation creates no hidden partial final table
Test Mode: Scenario E2E with deterministic model fixture
Coverage Status: Covered on the runtime with a deterministic model (Table kit headless program): one traceable row per receipt with the attachment once, values from the right receipt, an unreadable receipt stays a row to review, reopens from disk; a run cancelled part way removes the table file it made (a_cancelled_run_leaves_no_partial_table_behind)

User Goal: Generate channel copy and a product image from one concept row
Given: A product row contains Concept and Concept description; seeded AI fields have auto_update=false
When: The user explicitly runs one text field and one image field for the selected row
Expected Business Result: LinkedIn copy follows the configured length and tone; the image field stores the configured number of valid attachments generated from the same concept description
Critical Checks: Only requested cells run; text and image use appropriate model capabilities; attachments render after reload; other concept rows remain untouched; generated output is associated with the correct source row
Negative or Recovery Branch: Failure or cancellation preserves prior generated values and source fields; retry replaces or updates the requested cell without duplicating attachments
Test Mode: Mocked text and image AI-field E2E
Coverage Status: Covered; fixed: the seeded LinkedIn and Twitter copy prompts now name the concept and brief, which they did not. Only the asked cells run, text and image outputs, three pictures kept and replaced on rerun, a refused run keeps the value
